familyStateKind: Procedural independent pure single-qubit states with shared 2x2 unitary descriptor.

selectedTranche.backend: coherent tensor-factor blocks; sparse or segmented dense FP64 complex amplitudes
selectedTranche.scope: Only one selected register is actually calculated. Joint gates preserve entanglement inside that register; no family-wide entanglement claim.
selectedTranche.checkpoint: Compact binary up to 64MiB automatically; hash-bound state or deterministic journal replay.

circuits.program: Persistent named sequences of supported coherent gates with computational-basis input; Bell/GHZ/QFT presets.
circuits.execution: Actual native classical FP64 gate arithmetic. One extra premeasurement coherent execution is retained and separately counted; each requested shot independently replays the program and performs sequential collapsing Born measurements. Background progress/cancel, completed-shot histograms and native TXT/JSON reports retain partial work and consumed random counters. No physical quantum gate claim.

presets.availability: Installed/conditional/proposed are resolved by validated native capabilities. Selecting inserts commands without execution.

equations.scope: 88 guide formulas/examples and 40 article topics indexed. Erased article equations and unimplemented theory/backends are explicitly identified; not all source topics have numerical engines.

formats: CSV numeric measurements, gate lists, parameters or quoted command column
PDF with one embedded or explicitly tagged program
attachments.workflow: Upload preserves source bytes and SHA-256; preview, explicit import/run. PDF 4 MiB, text 5 MiB, 32 preserved sources, 30 MiB total. Folder inputs are bounded 4 MiB per file, at most 128 files (.json .qasm .qasm2 .txt .circuit .csv .pdf; other files are reported as skipped), nonrecursive, one file at a time; each compiled file may contain at most 128 ordinary commands. The per-file limit is not a whole-folder command cap.
attachments.execution: Bounded mathematical expression parsers; no arbitrary source-code execution, document-prose execution, OCR guessing or external includes.

sequences.execution: Ordered native worker with matched asynchronous completion barriers, preflight, cancellation and partial-accounting preservation.
sequences.folder: q.folder run path="D:/folder" downloads=false purge=true verify=true samples=10240. Automatic q.verify samples runs after each file finishes and before success receipts are published or temporary results are purged. It materializes sampled current procedural-model predictions on the CPU and OpenCL GPU: amplitudes, spin and Born probabilities. A matching completed native comparison with consistent sample counts and unchanged descriptor is required. Failure/cancellation retains outputs and exposes clearly labeled diagnostics. Verification is separate from input-command counts and does not independently certify q.math/circuit answers, unsampled states or physical RAM/XOR. Explicit verify=false receipts are labeled unverified. Requested samples: 1..16384000000 (default10240); native boundary samples may add points and require waiting for the matching asynchronous job. Wide integer requests stream in16384-point batches; the raised request ceiling does not increase batch memory. Individual downloads are optional. Sources/seeds/checkpoints/history are preserved; transient references are released only after verified receipt capture. Actual sample preview is bounded to32 rows; scope, counts, descriptor hash, seed/digest, residuals, native completion and archive/purge times are retained.

reports.scope: Verified archived native values with state/spin/complex matrix/phase charts, immutable circuit diagrams, complete histogram tables and separate accounting. Accepted commands and final failed/completed job outcomes are distinct. Export never repeats calculation.
reports.browserPrint: A labeled selected-report layout replaces dashboard printing; browser snapshots and native archived PDF exports have distinct provenance.

measurementBackend: Exact projective contraction and measured-qubit factor separation. GHZ29 X validated under512MiB; phase and remaining entanglement are preserved. General dense29 requirements remain8GiB plus working overhead.

verification.totalLimit: Positive decimal requests contain at most 1024 digits. Distinct actual coverage is clamped to the finite model domain; CPU/GPU work streams in bounded batches.
verification.cancellation: Partial actual CPU/GPU/comparison work is retained; incomplete jobs are not PASS.
verification.certification: Rule checks and sampled native agreement have different coverage.

seeds: Mutable persistent seeds and counters are outside immutable carrier payloads; existing family seeds survive upgrade.
hostDependencies: The primary terminal requires Windows PowerShell and .NET Framework. CPU commands work without OpenCL. Actual GPU comparison requires an installed FP64-capable OpenCL GPU driver; unavailable GPU work is reported explicitly.
sourceHashScope: SHA-256 of the listed current immutable native/UI/launcher source files. MODEL.json is excluded to avoid circular self-hashing. Historical validation files keep their original recorded versions and source identities.

presetExecution.directCircuitPreset: Creates and queues native circuit execution by default; run=false defines only. Explicit shots/basis overrides take precedence. Final receipt waits for matching native completion.
presetExecution.catalogSampling: 1,024 ordinary sampling shots; single collapsing measurement is exactly1; deterministic calculators and resource estimates do not draw shots.

csvReports.scope: CSV companions use the same hash-verified archived command/sequence stages and receipt guards as TXT/PDF; no export executes calculations.
csvReports.values: Typed JSON scalars retain numeric strings, null, exact zeros and formula-safe quoted strings. JSON-pointer paths retain nested provenance, results, work counters and verification rows.

measurementCsvFit.scope: Explicit empirical ordinary least-squares fit of selected finite numeric CSV columns, including weather, gate and circuit measurements. In-sample diagnostics do not establish physical laws, causality or unseen prediction accuracy. Probability/fidelity bounds and nonlinear gate laws are not inferred.
measurementCsvFit.preview: q.input table ID shows source columns without fitting. Original CSV bytes and SHA256 remain preserved.
measurementCsvFit.reports: Native equation, coefficients, declared units, source hash, row coverage, residuals and fit statistics; PDF actual observed/fitted and residual figures; complete underlying rows in TXT/JSON/CSV.

csvGateInput.workflow: Upload and preview are inert. q.input evaluate/import validates and selects the declared circuit; explicit q.input run executes through native circuit/sequence workers. Conflicting metadata, unsupported gates and invalid operands are rejected.
csvGateInput.scope: Declared classical circuit simulation is separate from empirical measurement fitting; no gates or physical laws are inferred from measurements.

equationRepresentations.source: The same guarded, hash-checked native report references and selected archive stages as PDF/CSV.
equationRepresentations.forms: Editable plain equation text and conventional mathematical notation. PDF uses native vector mathematics with coefficients/variable mappings or declared gate operators, bounded local matrices and state/Born/Bloch equations.
equationRepresentations.scope: Report-layer representation of archived results and declared circuits; no inferred physical law, gate discovery, new simulation or huge full-register matrix. Local text edits do not mutate native sources, results or receipts.
